0022600152.text: The San Antonio Spurs (2-2, 1-2 at home, on a two-game win streak) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (3-2, on a two-game losing streak), who still have one game to play before this one. Spurs are sitting 3rd in the Southwest, 2.5 games back and 7th in the West, while Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest, 1.5 games back and 6th in the West. Out for the Spurs are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and out for Minnesota are Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Spurs lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 regular season and won 4-2 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 139-109 win in Minneapolis on May 15, 2026.
